description.en: The name of the alert group in the JSON format.

description.zh:
CNAME接入域名类型：

- PUBLIC: 公网型
description.en:
The type of the canonical name (CNAME).

*   Set the value to PUBLIC.

description.zh:
是否强制更新。

- true-强制更新，不进行冲突提示。
- false|null-不强制更新，若遇冲突则提示。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable force updates. Valid values:

*   true: enables force update without a conflict alert.
*   false: disables force update. If a conflict occurs, the system displays an alert. null: This valid value of ForceUpdate provides the same information as the false value.

description.zh:
GTM实例ID。<props="china">可通过调用[DescribeDnsGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-29697.d_0_5_1_3_8_8.2aea3618RlSR9K)获取</props>

实例名称：首次更新必填，再次更新则非必填。
description.en: The name of the instance. This parameter is required only for the first update.

description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language of the values of specific response parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

description.zh:
公网域名接入方式：

- SYSTEM_ASSIGN:系统分配（此选项功能关闭）
- CUSTOM:自定义
description.en:
Specifies whether to use a custom CNAME domain name or a CNAME domain name assigned by the system to access the instance over the Internet. Valid values:

*   SYSTEM_ASSIGN: a CNAME domain name assigned by the system
*   CUSTOM: a custom CNAME domain name
The hostname corresponding to the CNAME domain name that is used to access the instance over the Internet.
The service domain name that is used over the Internet.

description.zh:
CNAME接入域名（公网）：主域名，且当为自定义接入时为必填。

> 此处应填入主域名，不包含PublicRr参数内容
description.en:
The CNAME domain name that is used to access the instance over the Internet, which is the primary domain name. This parameter is required when the PublicCnameMode parameter is set to CUSTOM.

>  You must use the primary domain name. Do not include the hostname specified by the PublicRr parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-dns-gtm-instance-global-config --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00 --instance-name test-1 --ttl 60 --public-cname-mode CUSTOM --public-user-domain-name example.com --public-zone-name www.example.com --alert-group test1_,_test2 --cname-type PUBLIC --alert-config EmailNotice=true SmsNotice=true NoticeType=ADDR_ALERT DingtalkNotice=true --public-rr test.rr --force-update true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns UpdateDnsGtmInstanceGlobalConfig --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-wwo3a3hbz00' --AlertConfig.1.SmsNotice true --Lang en --PublicZoneName 'www.example.com' --Ttl 60 --AlertConfig.1.EmailNotice true --InstanceName 'test-1' --AlertGroup 'test1_,_test2' --CnameType PUBLIC --PublicUserDomainName 'example.com' --AlertConfig.1.NoticeType ADDR_ALERT --AlertConfig.1.DingtalkNotice true --PublicRr 'test.rr' --ForceUpdate true --PublicCnameMode CUSTOM
